screens.title: Traditional & Contemporary Plates — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: Hero, ordering actions, the Thursday/Friday service window, both plate menus, delivery rules and the loyalty card.
screens.look: The moving meal ticker shows names without prices; the public header has no status strip or address.

screens.title: Traditional & Contemporary Plates — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The home page at 390×844, showing the responsive public storefront.
screens.look: Navigation collapses, basket remains available, and hero copy reflows for a phone.

screens.title: Meals — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The Traditional and Contemporary plate menus, with meal search, category navigation and both plate builders.
screens.look: The sticky category chips highlight the section currently in view.

screens.title: Meals — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: Dish photo, story, starch and vegetable-side choices, all included in the R100 plate price.
screens.look: The details use the current menu information without nutrition or unsupported dietary claims.

screens.title: Meals — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The plate builder lets customers choose a protein, a starch and a vegetable side at the fixed R100 plate price.
screens.look: Every component is included in the plate price, and delivery is included in turn.

screens.title: This Week — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The real service week: Thursday and Friday 12:00–13:30, both plate menus, delivery areas, minimum order and collection point.
screens.look: No day-of-week promotions are invented; specials are announced on WhatsApp.

screens.title: About Us | Our Story, Vision & Mission — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: How We Started, Vision, Mission, values and story timeline within About Us.
screens.look: Vision, Mission and How We Started are grouped under About Us rather than separate top-level links.

screens.title: Contact — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: Phone, WhatsApp, email, Thursday/Friday hours, delivery rules and the enquiry form, without a public business address.
screens.look: The form delivers to the business inbox; the exact collection point is confirmed by WhatsApp rather than published.

screens.title: Loyalty card — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: A simple loyalty card lookup by cell number, with stamp balance and reward details.
screens.look: The feature is called a loyalty card throughout the public site.

screens.title: Checkout — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The empty state shown when a customer reaches checkout without items.
screens.look: A clear route back to the menu, not a dead end.

screens.title: Checkout — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: A populated checkout with customer fields, collection selection, order summary and the current payment form.
screens.look: Delivery is included in the total, the service window is stated, and updates remain manual by phone or WhatsApp.

screens.title: Checkout — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The populated collection checkout rendered at 390×844.
screens.look: Fields and totals remain usable in the mobile layout.

screens.title: Order HB-0043V — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: Secure order receipt, item summary, payment and contact details.
screens.look: No live progress or automatic messages are claimed; the customer is told to contact the restaurant for a manual update.

screens.title: Order HB-0043V — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The secure order page at 390px, with details and direct contact actions.
screens.look: Order and contact information remains legible at phone width.

screens.title: Page not found — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The 404 route with the storefront shell, rather than a browser error page.
screens.look: A clear way back to the menu.

screens.title: Customer quest — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The customer-quest page: both plate menus as a view-only reference, then the request form.
screens.look: The reference contains no links, no buttons and no dish photos — nothing in it opens. A submitted quest is a request, not an order.

screens.title: Customer quest — Heritage Bites
screens.notes: The quest page at 390px: the view-only reference stacks above the request form.
screens.look: The reference stays readable and still opens nothing on a phone.
